static_package_readiness.score_policy: Static package readiness is evaluated from package structure, artifact metadata, BM25-friendly authoring coverage and chunkable Markdown content. It is separate from retrieval and answer readiness.

retrieval_readiness.blocking_reason: AI4BIZ index retrieval trace is missing; retrieval readiness is not scored.
retrieval_readiness.required_input: AI4BIZ RAG Console retrieval results for golden_questions.jsonl, including query_id, expected_doc_id, retrieved_doc_ids, rank and score.

answer_readiness.blocking_reason: Answer traces are missing; faithfulness, citation accuracy and answer readiness are not scored.
answer_readiness.required_input: Answer traces containing question_id, answer, citations, retrieved_context_ids and evaluator/faithfulness evidence.

final_score_policy: No combined benchmark score is produced unless static_package_readiness, retrieval_readiness and answer_readiness are all backed by required evidence.

local_bm25_smoke_test.note: Local BM25 package checks can support debugging but are not an AI4BIZ index readiness score.
